newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end sharply up on support buying.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end sharply up on support buying.

text.p: Shanghai's B share index ended sharply up 4.41 percent on Tuesday with institutions supporting shares with a heavy index weighting, brokers said.

The B index went up 3.625 points to 85.763 points on volume of 15.398 million shares worth $11.711 million. The A index rose 30.829 points or 2.36 percent to 1,338.650 points on turnover of 7.43 billion yuan.
B share investors were encouraged by a rise in the A share index on a lack of further official crackdown measures in recent days, brokers said.
Shanghai Lujiazui Finance and Trade Zone Development and Shanghai Dazhong Taxi got strong support from institutions, which triggered some bargain-hunting buying, brokers said.
Shanghai Lujiazui traded actively, ending up $0.068 or 4.99 percent to $1.430 on volume of 1.6 million shares.
Shanghai Dazhong was the second winner on institutional buying, soaring $0.140 or 9.21 percent to $1.660 on volume of 545,000 shares.
"Institutions made use of a strong rebound in the A shares to boost B shares," one broker said.
"But trading volume did not grow, indicating the market is likely to consolidate in the next few days," he said.
Of 43 B shares, 41 traded, with 33 up, three flat and five down.
Shanghai Refrigerator Compressor was the star on a technical rebound, soaring $0.072 or 10.02 percent to $0.790 on volume of 1.3 million shares.
Shanghai Jinqiao Export Processing Zone Development was the most actively traded on institutional cross trading, ending up $0.028 or 3.99 percent to $0.728 on volume of 2.8 million shares.
Shanghai's A share index also rebounded strongly on active institutional speculative buying, but its upward potential will be limited on expected unwinding selling and profit-taking, brokers said.
The SSE30 blue chip index put on 60.167 points or 1.54 percent to 3,968.505 points.
Shanghai 3F New Materials was the top gainer on a technical rebound, surging 0.66 yuan or 10.04 percent to 7.23 yuan on volume of 607,100 shares.
